release_notes: Added website support for visual quiz questions: accessible logo/question images are resized safely and synced to Cloudflare, then shown above the website question without exposing the answer.
Factburst website pages now use the app icon for the browser favicon and header branding instead of the temporary F badge.
Prepare website now refreshes existing staged quiz copies as well as new ones, so website media improvements can be applied without deleting or duplicating quizzes.
Fixed the Release Readiness layout at high DPI or narrower effective window widths by moving Prepare website out of the crowded header action row.

Added NAS-safe website staging from Scheduled Release Readiness: accessible scheduled quizzes can be copied to Cloudflare now and automatically appear at release time, while unavailable project folders are skipped for a later retry.
